claims.citation: New York Herald, 14 June 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
VALUABLE CARGO—Messrs Wilder & Fullarton yesterday
morning cleared the American ship Charlotte (1108 tons),
Capt W R Spear, for Liverpool, with a cargo consisting of
3119 bales of upland cotton, weighing 1,524[?],637 lbs, value
$502,717; 51 do sea island cotton, weighing 14,250 lbs, valued
at $9840 40. Total value of the cargo, $512,557.—Savannah
paper, June 7.
